## Classes

### <a name="curator"></a>`curator`

Curator is installed from PyPI into a Python virtualenv in `install_dir`.
The Curator wheel is checked against a SHA-256 checksum; its dependencies
come from the package index, at the versions es-client asks for.

The module writes Curator's client configuration (`curator.yml`) and an
actions file built from `curator::action` resources, and can run Curator
on a schedule with a systemd timer.

Curator 8.0.21, the default, works with Elasticsearch 7.14 to 8.x. Curator
9 works only with Elasticsearch 9: set `version` to `9.0.0` for those
clusters.

#### Examples

##### Delete Logstash indices older than 30 days every night

```puppet
class { 'curator':
  hosts       => ['https://es1.example.com:9200', 'https://es2.example.com:9200'],
  username    => 'curator',
  password    => Sensitive('change-me'),
  ca_certs    => '/etc/ssl/certs/es-ca.pem',
  on_calendar => '*-*-* 01:30:00',
  actions     => {
    'delete old logstash indices' => {
      'action'  => 'delete_indices',
      'order'   => 1,
      'options' => { 'ignore_empty_list' => true },
      'filters' => [
        { 'filtertype' => 'pattern', 'kind' => 'prefix', 'value' => 'logstash-' },
        { 'filtertype' => 'age', 'source' => 'name', 'direction' => 'older',
          'timestring' => '%Y.%m.%d', 'unit' => 'days', 'unit_count' => 30 },
      ],
    },
  },
}
```

##### Curator 9 for an Elasticsearch 9 cluster, with an API key

```puppet
class { 'curator':
  version       => '9.0.0',
  hosts         => ['https://es.example.com:9200'],
  api_key_token => Sensitive('base64-encoded-id-and-key'),
}
```

##### Installing only, with the configuration managed elsewhere

```puppet
class { 'curator':
  install_only => true,
}
```

##### <a name="-curator--version"></a>`version`

Data type: `Curator::Version`

The Curator release to install from PyPI, such as `8.0.21` or `9.0.0`.

##### <a name="-curator--wheel_checksums"></a>`wheel_checksums`

Data type: `Hash[Curator::Version, Curator::Sha256]`

SHA-256 checksums of Curator's wheels, keyed by release. The module's data
has 8.0.21 and 9.0.0; add others in Hiera (the hashes are merged) or set
`checksum`.

##### <a name="-curator--python_packages"></a>`python_packages`

Data type: `Array[String[1]]`

OS packages that provide `python` with the `venv` module. Defaults to
`python3-venv` on Debian and Ubuntu.

##### <a name="-curator--ensure"></a>`ensure`

Data type: `Enum['present', 'absent']`

`absent` removes the timer, the configuration and actions files and the
virtualenv. The configuration directory and `python_packages` are left
in place.

Default value: `'present'`

##### <a name="-curator--checksum"></a>`checksum`

Data type: `Optional[Curator::Sha256]`

SHA-256 of the Curator wheel. Defaults to the entry for `version` in
`wheel_checksums`; required for releases not listed there.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-curator--package_source"></a>`package_source`

Data type: `Optional[Variant[Stdlib::HTTPUrl, Stdlib::Absolutepath]]`

Where to get the Curator wheel: a URL, or the absolute path of a local
file. Defaults to the wheel for `version` on files.pythonhosted.org.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-curator--pip_options"></a>`pip_options`

Data type: `Array[String[1]]`

Extra options for `pip install`, such as
`['--index-url', 'https://pypi.example.com/simple']` for a mirror or
`['--proxy', 'http://proxy.example.com:3128']`.

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="-curator--install_dir"></a>`install_dir`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

The virtualenv Curator is installed into. `curator` is
`<install_dir>/bin/curator`.

Default value: `'/opt/curator'`

##### <a name="-curator--python"></a>`python`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

The Python interpreter that creates the virtualenv. Curator 8 needs
Python 3.8 or later, Curator 9 Python 3.10 or later.

Default value: `'/usr/bin/python3'`

##### <a name="-curator--manage_python"></a>`manage_python`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to install `python_packages`.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-curator--install_only"></a>`install_only`

Data type: `Boolean`

Only install Curator; leave `curator.yml` and the actions file alone.
`curator::action` can't be used then.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-curator--config_dir"></a>`config_dir`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Directory for `curator.yml` and the actions file, created root-only
(0700). `/root/.curator` is where Curator looks for `curator.yml` when
root runs it without `--config`.

Default value: `'/root/.curator'`

##### <a name="-curator--manage_config_dir"></a>`manage_config_dir`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to create `config_dir`.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-curator--config_file"></a>`config_file`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Path of Curator's client configuration file.

Default value: `"${config_dir}/curator.yml"`

##### <a name="-curator--actions_file"></a>`actions_file`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Path of the actions file.

Default value: `"${config_dir}/actions.yml"`

## Defined types

### <a name="curator--action"></a>`curator::action`

Each action is written under its `order`, which Curator runs in ascending
order, so every action needs its own. `options`, `filters`, `add` and
`remove` are written as given, in Curator's own format; see
https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/client/curator/current/actionfile.html.

Actions that work on a list of indices or snapshots need at least one
filter. To act on all of them, say so with `[{ 'filtertype' => 'none' }]`.

#### Examples

##### Delete Logstash indices older than 30 days

```puppet
curator::action { 'delete old logstash indices':
  action  => 'delete_indices',
  order   => 1,
  options => { 'ignore_empty_list' => true },
  filters => [
    { 'filtertype' => 'pattern', 'kind' => 'prefix', 'value' => 'logstash-' },
    { 'filtertype' => 'age', 'source' => 'name', 'direction' => 'older',
      'timestring' => '%Y.%m.%d', 'unit' => 'days', 'unit_count' => 30 },
  ],
}
```

##### Point an alias at this week's indices

```puppet
curator::action { 'logs-current alias':
  action  => 'alias',
  order   => 2,
  options => { 'name' => 'logs-current', 'warn_if_no_indices' => true },
  add     => {
    'filters' => [
      { 'filtertype' => 'pattern', 'kind' => 'prefix', 'value' => 'logs-' },
      { 'filtertype' => 'period', 'period_type' => 'relative', 'source' => 'name',
        'range_from' => 0, 'range_to' => 0, 'timestring' => '%Y.%m.%d', 'unit' => 'weeks' },
    ],
  },
  remove  => {
    'filters' => [
      { 'filtertype' => 'pattern', 'kind' => 'prefix', 'value' => 'logs-' },
    ],
  },
}
```

##### <a name="-curator--action--order"></a>`order`

Data type: `Integer[1]`

The action's number in the actions file. Curator runs actions in
ascending order; no two actions may share one.

##### <a name="-curator--action--action"></a>`action`

Data type: `Curator::ActionName`

The Curator action, such as `delete_indices` or `snapshot`. Defaults to
the title.

Default value: `$title`

##### <a name="-curator--action--description"></a>`description`

Data type: `String[1]`

The action's description, which Curator logs.

Default value: `$title`

##### <a name="-curator--action--options"></a>`options`

Data type: `Hash[String[1], Data]`

The action's options, such as `{ 'repository' => 'backups' }` for
`snapshot`.

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-curator--action--filters"></a>`filters`

Data type: `Array[Hash[String[1], Data]]`

The filters that pick the indices or snapshots to act on. Not used by
`alias`, `cluster_routing`, `create_index` and `rollover`.

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="-curator--action--add"></a>`add`

Data type: `Optional[Hash[String[1], Data]]`

`alias` only: filters for the indices to add to the alias, as
`{ 'filters' => [...] }`.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-curator--action--remove"></a>`remove`

Data type: `Optional[Hash[String[1], Data]]`

`alias` only: filters for the indices to remove from the alias, as
`{ 'filters' => [...] }`.

Default value: `undef`

## Data types

### <a name="Curator--ActionName"></a>`Curator::ActionName`

The actions Curator 8 and 9 can run from an actions file.

* **See also**
  * https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/client/curator/current/actions.html

Alias of `Enum['alias', 'allocation', 'close', 'cluster_routing', 'cold2frozen', 'create_index', 'delete_indices', 'delete_snapshots', 'forcemerge', 'index_settings', 'open', 'reindex', 'replicas', 'restore', 'rollover', 'shrink', 'snapshot']`

### <a name="Curator--Sha256"></a>`Curator::Sha256`

A SHA-256 checksum as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

Alias of `Pattern[/\A[0-9a-f]{64}\z/]`

### <a name="Curator--Version"></a>`Curator::Version`

A Curator release number as published on PyPI, such as `8.0.21`.

Alias of `Pattern[/\A[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)+([a-z0-9.+!-]*)\z/]`
